headline.caveat: JV dollar terms undisclosed. Stateline Power JV (Solaris 50.1% / xAI 49.9%) owns and operates mobile gas turbines for the Memphis-area Colossus cluster: ~400MW initially, targeting >1.1GW of fully operating turbines by Q2 2027 (~240MW more sits on-site outside the JV).

realized_to_date.caveat: JV capex is running (e.g., $112M in Q2 2025 alone) funded by both partners pro rata; xAI's cumulative contribution is not disclosed.

nature_md: xAI and Solaris Energy Infrastructure formed the Stateline Power JV (Solaris 50.1%, xAI 49.9%) to own and operate a fleet of mobile gas turbines (Solar Turbines Titan-350s, ~35-38MW each) powering xAI's Colossus data centers around Memphis, TN — behind-the-meter generation that sidesteps multi-year grid interconnection queues. Roughly 400MW deployed initially, with >1.1GW of fully operating capacity targeted by Q2 2027 and analyst expectations of options toward ~1.5GW. xAI is both JV co-owner and the sole power customer; Solaris consolidates the JV and books xAI's share as noncontrolling interest.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: xAI contributes JV equity (capitalized investment) and pays for delivered power as opex; as 49.9% owner it also bears its share of turbine capex. Structure keeps generation assets off xAI's own balance sheet while securing dedicated supply. Air-permit litigation around the Memphis turbines is a contingent risk.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Solaris consolidates Stateline Power (50.1%), booking power-services revenue from its single customer and reporting xAI's stake as noncontrolling interest; turbine fleet capex is funded by both partners, transforming Solaris from oilfield services into an AI-power growth story.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** the fastest power-to-compute pathway in the industry — Colossus 2 reached gigawatt scale years before grid-served rivals, at ~$2.7M/MW. **Bear:** single-customer JV economics, unresolved air-permit challenges in Memphis, and merchant gas exposure if xAI's buildout pauses; Solaris' equity story is now one counterparty's capex plan.
